summary: postinstall beacon to anonymous webhook.site collector
details: The package declares a postinstall script that runs index.js on npm install. index.js issues a POST request with a JSON body containing an event tag ('authorized-poc-test'), a random test identifier, and a status field to a hardcoded webhook.site URL (https://webhook.site/0a4d6535-e2dd-46b7-aff7-8af65c145c50). webhook.site is an anonymous request collector not associated with any legitimate package infrastructure. The script also reads the installer's hostname and current working directory, logging them locally. The package self-identifies as a proof-of-concept via [POC] log tags. Installing the package auto-executes outbound network contact to an anonymous third-party endpoint without consent, confirming successful install on the target host to the operator of the collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
